title: All-short attention: kill the long (2048) layers
description: WINDOW_PATTERN "SSSL" -> "S" and deleted the window_sizes[-1] = (long_window, 0) override, so all 8 layers use window 512 (zero global layers); FLOPs/token 220.2M -> 201.4M, nothing else changed.
reflection: Tests whether the two remaining full-2048 layers are load-bearing or are the worst of the cross-document contamination that made 1024->512 a 7-sigma win. Deletes a line rather than adding one. Reads against a0's 7-short+1-long run as the 2/1/0 global-layer series, and against a2's //8 run as an equal-FLOP (201M) A/B on span SHAPE (uniform 512 vs very local 256 plus two global).
